data.name: Hallock
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'halh' meaning 'hollow' or 'safe place' and 'roc' meaning 'rock'. Hallock can mean 'hollow rock' or 'rocky hill'. This name may have been given to a child born near a rocky hill or to one whose family lived in such a place.

Thus, the name Hallock may carry the profound meaning: "May the child's life be built on the strong foundation of faith, finding refuge and protection in God, and transforming the heart into a vessel worthy of His love and presence."
